mapper.sql: id, position_id AS positionId, name, ad_type AS adType, image_url AS imageUrl, url, text_content AS textContent, html_code AS htmlCode, weight, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, status, count_view AS countView, count_click AS countClick, remark, sort, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: select from fly_ad where position_id = #{positionId} and status = 1 and (start_time is null or start_time <= now()) and (end_time is null or end_time >= now()) order by weight desc, sort, id desc limit #{rows}
mapper.insert:
insert into fly_ad
id, position_id, name, ad_type, image_url, url, text_content, html_code, weight, start_time, end_time, status, count_view, count_click, remark, sort, create_time, update_time,
